observatory.note: A long white two-storey body with three domes where OpenStreetMap maps them: the planetarium's over a drum south of the middle, and a telescope dome on each end of the north front

records.note: A round tower of thirteen storeys with a sunshade ringing every floor and a spire on top, on a two-storey base, for a building made to look like a stack of records

bandshell.note: A quarter-sphere shell of stepped rings over the stage, open toward the seats, on a backstage block

geodesic.note: A low dome over the whole footprint, for a cinema built as a geodesic dome
